# Exchanges sharing a relatum need not commute

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`order-of-exchanges-sharing-a-relatum` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](order-of-exchanges-sharing-a-relatum.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Two exchanges sharing their relatum, taken in two orders from one configuration, can reach different configurations: the condition of act_comm cannot be dropped.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. One relatum, two exchanges touching it, one adding one and one doubling: they share the relatum, and adding then doubling gives two while doubling then adding gives one. (`Becoming.Interleavings.Shared.law`, `Becoming.Interleavings.Shared.order_matters`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; one constructed local law.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which actual exchanges share relata.
